# `bs init`

- **Usage:** `bs init [--store <STORE>] [--editor <EDITOR>]`

Set up a store and configuration without overwriting existing configuration

## Flags
- **`--store <STORE>`**
- **`--editor <EDITOR>`** — Editor command with quoted arguments, e.g. 'code --wait'; no shell evaluation. Otherwise use VISUAL or EDITOR
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
